lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₁₄Zn crystallizes in the hexagonal system with space group P-6m2 (No. 15) and a 15-atom unit cell (Mg₁₄Zn), containing five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows that all Mg and Zn centers adopt a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each, with neighbor distances ranging from 3.16 to 3.24 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Mg–Mg corner, edge, and face sharing, as well as Mg–Zn corner and edge sharing.
